Beats me.

>Q2. Does Heart of Darkness change ALL agg. damage to normal ie. non - combat
>agg ? mmmmmm possibilities.

Yes. Our group had a couple incarnations of the Unblockable Heart
Deck, where Daring the Dawn was flung round liberally on any action
they saw fit - and then one normal damage was applied to the vampire.
If it wasn't such a pain to get tha/FOR/ser, Rutor's Hand would've
been tossed in too. Usually the routine was "I hunt (or Restore,
usually). I Force of Will. I slap Daring the Dawn and (insert bleed
modifier) on it. Darn, I take two points of normal damage."

-- Derek

Since card text doesn't provide any consequence, the answer is: No, there is
no consequnce.

> Q2. Does Heart of Darkness change ALL agg. damage to normal ie. non - combat
> agg ? mmmmmm possibilities.

Yes.

> Q3. Is the action to recruit Charnos the Imp at the usual +1 stealth or the

> effect of putting him on another unfortunate recipient or both or what ? -
> ahhh my head hurts.

it is a +1 stealth directed action (unless you put him on a minion you
control, in which case it is undirected).
